method: own scripted + random rollouts only (no external RAM maps / disassembly). Frames rendered to verify screen state. Start state is the pre-door platform in Vegetable Valley Stage 1; progress in this ROOM-BASED game is via a DOOR (walk-left ~16px, press UP grounded) into a horizontal scrolling room.

noop_flat_v.verdict: FLAT under NOOP -> not a frame counter (rejection test the MM2 $001C bootstrap failed)

hold_right_v.verdict: monotone rising, steady ~+5/step (Kirby walk @ fs=4), crosses 256 page boundary

gameplay_locked_wrap_test.reconstruction: hi*256+lo continuous (|delta|<64) 99.9% of steps across 8 worker trajectories
gameplay_locked_wrap_test.verdict: 0x0083 wraps 255->0 exactly when 0x0095 increments (and 0->255 when it decrements) = a true 16-bit world-X, gameplay-locked (NOT fixed-cadence)

player_y.verdict: standing ~148; jump dips to ~64 (up = smaller y), returns to base; flat under NOOP -> Kirby vertical position (wide dynamic range for a flyer)

health.stability: constant 6 across ~70,000 scripted+random steps (8-worker fly/inhale + grounded)
health.verdict: 0x0025 == 6 == the 6 HUD health orbs on the title card, with 5 HUD display-mirror tiles at 0x06B4-0x06B8; rock-stable. Decrement NOT triggerable in the forgiving opening (Kirby hover/inhale took zero damage in 70k+ steps) -> used as the death proxy per task guidance.

area_room_id.verdict: per-room SCENE id: 58 on the start platform, 62 in the post-door horizontal room; constant within a room, steps at the door, increases forward (58<62) so the deep-frontier bias follows Kirby through doors. Monotone across the FULL stage unverified.

lives.zero_page_eq4_stable: none (all ==4 constants are in the 0x05xx-0x07xx HUD/tile buffer: 0x057E,0x0599,0x05C3,0x0640,0x0714 — unverified display tiles)
lives.level_id_candidate: 0x0030 == 1 (constant = Vegetable Valley "Level 1"; would increment on a real stage clear — unverified, cannot beat the stage in bootstrap)
lives.verdict: no clean zero-page lives counter found; death is proxied by health (0x0025 < 6). Consistent with task guidance.

rejected.0x0022: churns wildly under NOOP and every input (net thousands) = free-running clock/RNG — rejected as progress (the $001C-class trap)
rejected.0x0071: direction-sensitive but huge unbounded net + wraps every step = sub-pixel/velocity accumulator, not a clean position
rejected.0x006A: fast fractional X (changes ~every step), mono 0.7 — sub-position, not the page-clean world-X
rejected.0x04xx/0x05xx/0x06xx spikes: tile/nametable/OAM staging buffers: single large writes at scroll updates gave false mono=1.0; excluded
